content:
Hi everyone :wave:

I have been trying to setup a minimal Literate Programming example project with Verso.

I managed to generate some HTML file and the docstrings have been properly parsed and rendered, but the docstring comments tags also appear in the output, which I guess is not intended?

I probably have made a newbie mistake in the setup. Can anyone see what the issue may be?
Alternatively, can you point me to an example of a tiny "Verso / Literate Programming" reference project?
(I believe that https://github.com/leanprover/verso-templates does not contain a literate programming example (?))

I'll setup a proper github repo with the full example if my description of the issue is too vague.

Best,

Sébastien
I think you may just need to try the literateHtml facet, this looks like the literateCode facets output

Hi @Rob Simmons,

I think that's what I'm doing already (?). I build the project with

lake build :literateHtml
lake exe verso-html .lake/build/literate html

The repository: https://github.com/boisgera/Dummy
Aah, you're doing an extra step — lake build :literateHtml already puts the output you want in .lake/build/literate-html
Much better, thank you ! :pray:
